fields.description: Master switch for the nightly job. Off = nothing runs automatically; you can still build manually.
fields.label: MD Enabled

fields.description: How many recent months to rebuild each night. 2 = current + previous. 3 given how late your sweep journals land.
fields.label: MD Rebuild Months

fields.description: Hour of day, 24-hour clock. 2 means 02:00, i.e. 2 AM. The job is registered hourly and exits immediately unless the current hour matches — so changing the time is a settings edit, not a deploy.
fields.label: MD Run Hour

fields.description: Currency. A control variance above this counts as drift. 1.00 ignores rounding, catches real problems.
fields.label: MD Drift Threshold

fields.description: Leave on. It exists so you can turn it off in front of the CEO and show the $3.87M figure the old reports gave.
fields.label: MD Exclude Internal Transfers

fields.description: How internal transfers are identified. GL contra account is the working option. The Daily Cash Transfer link option exists for the day that field gets filled — it's 0% today.
fields.label: MD Transfe Detection
fields.options:
GL contra account
Daily Cash Transfer link
Both

fields.description: Whether draft invoices count as sales. 0 — the CEO's answer to question 2.
fields.label: MD Include Drafts

fields.description: Who gets emailed when a period drifts.
fields.label: MD Alert Recipients

fields.description: Accounts whose debits are payment-time write-offs. → Discount - SH
fields.label: MD Payment Discount Accounts

fields.description: Accounts carved out as doctor commission. → 50010 - Doctors' Salaries & Commissions - SH
fields.label: MD Commission Accounts

fields.description: Accounts carved out as staff salary. → 5213 - Salary - SH
fields.label: MD Payroll Accounts
